description: This file defines theme-related functions for a frontend project, including a base theme object with colors and typography, and functions to generate categorical color palettes and category-to-color mappings.

methods.name: getOceanTheme
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette for categorical data, seeded by the Ocean theme colors, with support for more than the seed colors.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category names to colors using the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
